instruction: Build and test against Node.js 18, 20, and 22 using a strategy matrix.
output:
name: node-matrix
on: push
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        node: [18, 20, 22]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: ${{ matrix.node }}
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm test

instruction: Run the test suite on Ubuntu, macOS, and Windows runners with an OS matrix.
output:
name: os-matrix
on: push
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest, windows-latest]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Run tests
        run: python -m pytest

instruction: Test across Python 3.10, 3.11, and 3.12 with fail-fast disabled so all versions always run.
output:
name: python-matrix
on: push
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        python: ['3.10', '3.11', '3.12']
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python }}
      - run: pip install -r requirements.txt && pytest

instruction: Add an include entry to the Node matrix that marks Node 22 as experimental.
output:
name: matrix-include
on: push
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        node: [18, 20]
        include:
          - node: 22
            experimental: true
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: ${{ matrix.node }}
      - name: Test
        continue-on-error: ${{ matrix.experimental == true }}
        run: npm test

instruction: Exclude the combination of Windows and Node 18 from an OS-by-Node matrix.
output:
name: matrix-exclude
on: push
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, windows-latest]
        node: [18, 20]
        exclude:
          - os: windows-latest
            node: 18
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: ${{ matrix.node }}
      - run: npm test

instruction: Limit a matrix build to at most two concurrent jobs with max-parallel.
output:
name: max-parallel
on: push
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      max-parallel: 2
      matrix:
        shard: [1, 2, 3, 4]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: ./scripts/run-shard.sh ${{ matrix.shard }}

instruction: Run coverage upload only on the Python 3.12 leg of a Python version matrix.
output:
name: coverage-one-version
on: push
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python: ['3.10', '3.11', '3.12']
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python }}
      - run: pip install -r requirements.txt && pytest --cov=src
      - name: Upload coverage
        if: matrix.python == '3.12'
        run: bash <(curl -s https://codecov.io/bash)

instruction: Run the Ruby test suite on Ruby 3.1, 3.2, and 3.3 in a matrix.

instruction: Compile and test the project on Java 17 and 21 with a Gradle matrix build.
output:
name: java-matrix
on: push
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        java: [17, 21]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: temurin

instruction: Give each matrix job a readable name showing both the OS and Node version.
output:
name: named-matrix
on: push
jobs:
  test:
    name: Test on ${{ matrix.os }} with Node ${{ matrix.node }}
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest]
        node: [20, 22]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: ${{ matrix.node }}
      - run: npm test

instruction: Use include to assign a larger macOS runner to one specific matrix entry.
output:
name: matrix-runner-override
on: push
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest]
        include:
          - os: macos-latest
            runs-on: macos-14
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: make test

instruction: Build only on Ubuntu while running tests on other operating systems using a matrix include list.
output:
name: matrix-split-tasks
on: push
jobs:
  matrix-job:
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      matrix:
        include:
          - os: ubuntu-latest
            task: build
          - os: macos-latest
            task: test
          - os: windows-latest
            task: test
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: make ${{ matrix.task }}

instruction: Run an experimental job that is allowed to fail alongside the stable suite leg.
output:
name: experimental-matrix
on: push
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - suite: stable
            allowed_failure: false
          - suite: nightly
            allowed_failure: true
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Run suite
        continue-on-error: ${{ matrix.allowed_failure }}
        run: ./scripts/run-suite.sh ${{ matrix.suite }}

instruction: Validate the configuration against Terraform 1.5.7 and 1.6.6 with a version matrix.
output:
name: terraform-matrix
on: push
jobs:
  validate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        tf: ['1.5.7', '1.6.6']
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: hashicorp/setup-terraform@v3
        with:
          terraform_version: ${{ matrix.tf }}
      - run: terraform fmt -check -recursive
      - run: terraform init -backend=false && terraform validate

instruction: Start PostgreSQL 14, 15, and 16 service containers for a database matrix test.
output:
name: postgres-matrix
on: push
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        postgres: [14, 15, 16]
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:${{ matrix.postgres }}
        env:
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: test
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd pg_isready
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: pip install -r requirements.txt
      - run: pytest --db-url postgresql://postgres:test@localhost:5432/postgres

instruction: Publish the package from only the newest Node version of a matrix build.
output:
name: publish-one-matrix-leg
on: push
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        node: [18, 20, 22]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: ${{ matrix.node }}
      - run: npm ci && npm run build
      - name: Publish
        if: matrix.node == 22
        run: npm publish --access public
        env:
          NODE_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}

instruction: Run Playwright browser tests for Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit with a browser matrix.
output:
name: browser-matrix
on: push
jobs:
  e2e:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        browser: [chromium, firefox, webkit]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npx playwright install --with-deps ${{ matrix.browser }}
      - run: npx playwright test --project=${{ matrix.browser }}
